headline: Argentina country risk index tops 1,000 basis points as sovereign debt slumps
summary: Argentina’s country risk metric breached 1,000 basis points following a sharp sell-off in government bonds. Investor sentiment was depressed by fiscal uncertainties ahead of the 2027 midterms and global market volatility.
why: Country risk metrics track the yield spread of sovereign debt over US Treasuries, determining foreign borrowing costs for governments and domestic firms.

impacts.name: Argentina 10-year sovereign bond yield
impacts.why: Selling pressure drove down sovereign bond prices, causing risk spreads over US Treasuries to surpass 1,000 basis points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fiscal concerns and political uncertainty caused investors to dump Argentine government bonds.
